_doc: AUTHORED - the artifact timeline (tools/artifact_timeline.py, /artifact-timeline). main = the numbered track in order (number = position + 1), each with the floor the timeline puts it on; environment = the recurring works that make space, shown smaller; removed = taken off the path, with the reason. Seeded from the tower: floor, then the nearest stop of that floor's hand-made route, or on a floor without one a short walk from the arrival shaft.
